title: Puzzle 2d Play End To End
description: Make puzzle 2d play work end-to-end: fix vite/build blockers (3d export renames breaking 5d/platform chain), verify dev server and e2e.
summary: Puzzle 2D play works end-to-end: Nakagin fixtures load from puzzle/*/fixture/ (not @puzzle/assets). Playground host imports fixed (boardFixtureNodeCaption, IconSelector, windowMeasuresToGolden). Platform uses compose5d from @puzzle/5d/react. Vitest 3/3 and Playwright e2e "opens board background" pass.
